content: Chroma + side-by-side diff alignment pitfalls: (1) Multi-byte UTF-8 chars (Cyrillic, Greek, CJK) cause ANSI color bleeding — Chroma inserts escape codes at byte offsets, not rune/visual-width positions. (2) East Asian wide characters (width 2) and ambiguous-width chars require go-runewidth for correct column alignment. (3) Never use len() or len([]rune()) for measuring visual string width in aligned output — use mattn/go-runewidth or lipgloss.Width(). (4) Chroma ANSI output must be post-processed through ANSI-aware truncation before placing into side-by-side columns. (5) When syntax-highlighted lines are placed in parallel columns, each column's ANSI state is independent — reset sequences at column boundaries to prevent color bleed across columns.
